description:
WHAT: Port methods/mod.rs from reference — response types, Patch<T>, SessionClient, all input/patch structs, JMAP helpers.

SOURCE: ~/PROJECT/crate-jmapchat-client/src/methods/mod.rs (1087 lines). Port entirely, adapting imports.

ALGORITHM:
1. Create crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/mod.rs and crate-jmap-chat-client/src/methods/ directory
2. Response types (derive Deserialize, serde rename_all camelCase):
   - GetResponse<T>, QueryResponse, ChangesResponse, SetResponse<T = serde_json::Value>
   - QueryChangesResponse, AddedItem, TypingResponse, PushSubscriptionCreateResponse
   - SetError { error_type: String, description: Option<String>, server_retry_after: Option<UTCDate> }
3. Patch<T> enum (Keep, Set(T), Clear) with:
   - Default = Keep; Serialize impl (returns error for Keep); Deserialize impl
   - is_keep(&self) -> bool; map_entry(&self) -> Result<Option<Value>, serde_json::Error>
   - From<T> for Patch<T>
4. All input types (port from reference, substituting):
   - crate::jmap::UTCDate → jmap_types::UTCDate
   - crate::types::* → jmap_chat_types::* or crate::types::* (for ContactPresenceFilter/QuotaScope)
   - crate::types::BodyType → check exact path in jmap_chat_types (likely jmap_chat_types::BodyType or similar)
   - Keep all struct names identical to reference
5. Constants: CALL_ID = "r1", USING_CHAT, USING_QUOTAS, USING_CORE, USING_CHAT_PUSH as &[&str] constants
6. SessionClient struct: { client: JmapClient, session: jmap_base_client::Session }
   - pub fn session_parts(&self) -> Result<(&str, &str), ClientError>: (api_url, chat_account_id)
   - pub fn api_url(&self) -> &str
   - async fn call_internal(&self, req: &JmapRequest) -> Result<JmapResponse, ClientError>
7. build_request(method: &str, args: Value, using: &[&str]) -> JmapRequest using jmap_types::JmapRequest::new and Invocation type
8. resolve_client_id(id: Option<&str>) -> String using ulid::Ulid::new().to_string() as fallback
9. Declare module in lib.rs: pub mod methods;

DEFENSIVE RULES:
- Patch::Keep serializes to a runtime error (never silently sends null)
- All Option<T> fields in input types use #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
- All Patch<T> fields use #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Patch::is_keep")]
- No unwrap() without comment

TESTS:
- patch_serialize_set: Patch::Set(42u32) serializes as 42
- patch_serialize_clear: Patch::Clear serializes as null
- patch_serialize_keep: Patch::Keep returns error from serde (not silently null)
- patch_deserialize_value: json 42 → Set(42)
- patch_deserialize_null: json null → Clear
- patch_deserialize_absent: missing field + #[serde(default)] → Keep
- get_response_roundtrip: deserialize GetResponse<String> from spec-shaped JSON

ACCEPTANCE: 7 named tests pass; cargo check -p jmap-chat-client; clippy clean
